text:
Mike has 5 - 2 = 3 pen pals remaining.
Each pen pal receives 2 letters per week, with each letter being 5 pages long:
3 pen pals × 2 letters/week × 5 pages/letter = 30 pages per week.

At 6 minutes per page, the total writing time is:
30 pages × 6 minutes/page = 180 minutes per week.

Convert minutes to hours:
180 minutes ÷ 60 minutes/hour = 3 hours.

ANSWER: 3
